verdict.rationale: A desktop app is a fair question for an authenticator product, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only mobile implementations and mobile UI gestures such as swiping and touch-and-hold. Cross-device sync and the PAM module do not amount to a first-class desktop app for viewing codes or accessing the vault on a computer.

support.subject: As a power user, a first-class desktop app gives me codes and vault access on my computer, not just on mobile
